description: EXAMPLE ONLY. Upright array with cable edge up, nominally 80 mm BELOW the camera. Not the new printed holder; measure and calibrate your actual pair. Camera axes: right/down/forward. All translations in metres.
wrist_usage: Set mode to wrist only when BOTH sensors are fixed together. Robot-frame previews also require a measured T_tool_from_camera, robot_calibrated=true, a calibration_id, and a synchronized stationary pose packet. Never substitute an identity transform as a guessed calibration.
